column1: # Test vectors for the Kannada text normalization profile (NORMALIZATION.md).
# Columns: id, form, rules, input, expected, note.
# form: canonical, legacy or search. Normalizing input to that form gives expected.
# rules: the rule ids that change the input, comma-separated, or - for none. A
#   conforming implementation need not count rules; kannadi checks that these rules,
# input and expected spell {ZWNJ} for U+200C, {ZWJ} for U+200D and {U+XXXX} for any
#   other code point. vectors.json has the same vectors as plain strings.

column6: the nukta comes before the virama
